description: Pasting an invitation another person already redeemed shows the heading "Invitation belongs to a different recipient" with the hint "This invitation was already used by someone else. Ask for a new one." The heading suggests it was addressed to someone else; the hint says it was used. Two explanations of one fact in one box.
expected: One plain statement: "This invitation was already used. Ask Tom for a new one."
actual: Server message as heading plus a differently worded hint.
suggested_fix: For INVITE_USED, show the friendly hint as the only text (or replace the server message with a mapped title).

description: Pasting her own Agent invitation into Start or join -> Join a project is accepted silently: the one-time Agent invitation becomes "redeemed", no new Actor appears (the same harness maps onto her existing agent Cobalt), and the page just returns to the same board with no message.
expected: The Join form recognises an Agent invitation and says it is meant for an agent's `client join`, or at least reports "You are already in Mobile onboarding v3; nothing changed" without spending the invitation.
actual: Invite list shows the agent invitation state "redeemed"; actor count unchanged at 6; no feedback.
suggested_fix: Check invitation purpose on the Welcome Join form as Link this device does, and refuse Agent invitations with guidance.

description: Tom's My device invitation and Tom's Agent invitation both give "Destination already belongs to another identity" plus a hint that explains My device and Human invitations only. For the Agent case the hint never mentions agent invitations; "Destination" is jargon.
expected: Name the invitation's purpose: "This is an Agent invitation from Tom. Ask him for a Human invitation."
actual: Same jargon heading and hint for device and agent invitations.
suggested_fix: Decode the purpose client-side before submit and show a purpose-specific message.

description: Pasting a message that holds two invitations returns "Paste one complete Pardner invitation" with the hint "Check that you pasted the whole invitation, exactly as it was sent." The hint points at truncation, not at the real cause (two invitations).
expected: "This text contains 2 invitations. Paste only the one for this project."
suggested_fix: Return a distinct code for multiple envelopes, or detect it client-side.

description: Tom's and Raj's default setup agents both appear as "SA" avatars and "Setup agent · agent" twice in Assigned to, with no owner shown.
expected: Agent labels include the owner, e.g. "Setup agent (Tom)".
suggested_fix: Qualify duplicate agent display names with the owning human's name.
